iterations.materialPrompt: Edit the attached object artwork into a tactile premium Korean learning-app illustration. Keep its exact subject, object count, recognizable silhouette, muted dancheong palette, camera angle, and gentle upper-left lighting. Coffee mugs: visibly hand-thrown stoneware, subtle mineral speckles and tiny unevenness under a thin celadon/ivory glaze, delicate broad specular highlights only on glaze. Keep elegant gold details restrained. Tray: real fine pale oak grain and pores. Coffee beans: a dry roasted surface with a visible natural crease. IMPORTANT: completely remove every surrounding glow, colored haze, fog and radial vignette. There must be no pixels of backdrop or drop shadow around the objects. Do not add a background, white square, ground plane or new decorative motifs. Square canvas with all objects inside a safe central 82% region and generous transparent margin. Materials must remain distinguishable when downscaled, through physical texture and gentle reflectance, not a uniform noise overlay. No letters, characters, UI or watermarks.
iterations.method: native image_gen, transparent background, no pixel post-processing
